extracted.intended_audience: corporate communications, sustainability/ESG teams, and investor-relations professionals preparing ESG/sustainability press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for drafting ESG/sustainability press releases that are factual, verifiable, and aligned with major reporting frameworks; emphasizes anti-greenwashing, required disclosures, and links to formal reports and verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major Reporting Standards Underlying ESG Releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases should be grounded in recognized sustainability/reporting standards and frameworks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GRI (Global Reporting Initiative); SASB (Sustainability Accounting Standards Board); TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures); CDP (formerly Carbon Disclosure Project); ESRS (European Sustainability Reporting Standards); CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive - EU); IFRS S1/S2 (International Sustainability Standards Board).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific metrics (not vague claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use precise, quantified metrics rather than vague or qualitative assertions about ESG performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-over-year comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide comparative figures showing performance relative to prior periods (e.g., year-over-year changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Baseline year reference
rubrics_metrics.description: State the baseline year against which progress or targets are measured.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology / standard used (GRI, SASB, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the measurement methodology or reporting standard used to produce the disclosed metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name the framework(s) applied (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, IFRS S1/S2) so numbers are interpretable and comparable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party verification (where applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether metrics or claims have been verified by an independent auditor or assurance provider.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the auditor/verifier where relevant and link to verification statements or reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope 1, 2, 3 emissions breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: When reporting emissions, break them out by Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 to clarify coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targets vs. progress
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly distinguish stated targets/commitments from achieved results and show progress toward targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish targets from achievements and make time-bound commitments explicit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental topics to cover
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the release addresses the relevant environmental subject areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carbon emissions; Water use; Waste reduction; Renewable energy; Biodiversity; Land use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social topics to cover
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the release addresses key social subject areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diversity statistics; Pay equity; Worker safety; Community investment; Human rights; Supply chain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance topics to cover
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the release addresses governance-related matters relevant to ESG readers and investors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Board diversity; Executive compensation; Ethics policies; Anti-corruption; Cybersecurity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti-Greenwashing Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards to prevent misleading, vague, or unsubstantiated ESG claims in press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid vague terms (e.g., 'green', 'sustainable' without metrics); Use specific numbers not promises; Make time-bound commitments; Obtain/indicate third-party verification; Use comparable methodology; State baseline year; Disclose methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honest Framing
rubrics_metrics.description: Frame ESG statements transparently, distinguishing aspirations from evidence-backed achievements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish targets from achievements; Specify scope (organization, product, supply chain); Note methodology limitations; Acknowledge gaps; Discuss trade-offs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defensible Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Support assertions with citations, documentation, and clear assumptions so claims are defensible to stakeholders or regulators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite the reporting standard; Provide supporting documentation link; Identify auditor/verifier; Specify time period covered; Note underlying assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid vague language / superlatives without proof
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not use unqualified superlatives or vague adjectives to describe ESG performance unless supported by evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid phrases like 'most sustainable' or 'industry-leading' unless backed by comparable, verifiable proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time-bound commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure all commitments have explicit target dates or time horizons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparable methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Use and disclose methodologies that enable comparison across periods and with peers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose methodologies and standards used to make figures comparable; explain any changes to methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology disclosed
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide accessible information about calculation methods, data sources, boundary definitions, and assumptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include notes on limitations and assumptions so readers can interpret figures correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify scope (org, product, supply chain)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly state the boundary of what is being reported—e.g., corporate-level, product-level, or supply-chain scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Note methodology limitations / acknowledge gaps
rubrics_metrics.description: Be transparent about data limitations, estimation methods, and areas where data is incomplete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Call out limitations so stakeholders understand the confidence and constraints around reported figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide supporting documentation link / full report linked
rubrics_metrics.description: Link to detailed reports, datasets, or appendices so stakeholders can validate and explore claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a link to the full ESG/sustainability report or underlying documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify auditor/verifier
rubrics_metrics.description: When third-party assurance is used, name the provider and, where possible, link to their assurance statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify time period
rubrics_metrics.description: State the reporting period the metrics relate to (e.g., fiscal year ending 20XX).

rubrics_metrics.name: Note assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose key assumptions used in calculations or modelling that affect reported metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESG team contact provided
rubrics_metrics.description: Include contact details for the ESG or sustainability team for follow-up questions from media, investors, or stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor implications noted
rubrics_metrics.description: Where relevant, highlight how ESG results or targets affect investor-relevant metrics or financial implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aligned with regulatory framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate alignment with applicable regulatory or disclosure requirements (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, IFRS S1/S2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite relevant directives/regulations and how disclosures map to them where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder impacts addressed
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the impacts of the company’s actions on stakeholders (employees, communities, suppliers, customers).
